High is based on THREE official domains agreeing, not on several pages of one domain: (1) apollohospitals.com (own doctor profile + Jubilee Hills liver-transplant unit index), (2) apollo247.com official doctor/booking page, (3) rainbowhospitals.in - a genuinely independent hospital domain - carrying him as Liver Transplant Surgeon at its Banjara Hills Road children's campus under the expanded surname. Liver transplantation is a small field in Hyderabad and no rival same-name liver transplant surgeon appeared in this city, so the Apollo/Rainbow dual attachment is read as one person; a human may still wish to confirm the Rainbow attachment is current. Our doctor trained at Tirupati/PGIMER Chandigarh/SGPGIMS Lucknow with a Medanta transplant fellowship and practises in Hyderabad - different city, different hospitals, different training.
